title: Your star card
sub: Enter your WhatsApp number and we'll send your card to it.
why: We don't show it here so nobody else can see yours.
sent: If your number is registered, your card was sent to you on WhatsApp.
sentHint: Didn't get it? Make sure it's the number you gave the barbershop, or ask for it on your next visit.
askTitle: Ask the barbershop for your card
ask: They'll give it to you with a QR code. Message them or ask on your next visit.
off: This barbershop doesn't use a star card.

errors.phone: Enter your full WhatsApp number (10 digits in Mexico).
errors.generic: We couldn't process your request. Please try again.
errors.network: No connection. Check your internet and try again.
errors.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.

install.title: Keep it handy
install.body: Add your card to your home screen and open it with one tap, like an app.
install.iphoneStep1: Tap Share in your browser's toolbar.
install.done: Done: your card is now on your home screen.
